scope: Local full-potential tangent fit for the locked mode-1 candidate. Modes 0, 1, and 2 potential time derivatives and constant pressures are fitted on a split physical patch. Mode-0 derivatives change the mean state; no moments, cones, finite-time integration, PDE, or scale-recursion acceptance is claimed.

inputs.convention: physical time t=-tau; u=mean+Re(sum V_m c_m), pressure=mean+Re(sum P_m p_m)

frozen_cache.weighting: physical cylindrical volume weights repeated over angles

design.definition: weighted residual columns; full columns are mode0/1/2 velocity derivatives and pressure gradients; restricted columns are scalar mode1 amplitude derivative plus mode1/2 pressures

analytic_column_check.note: Finite-difference check at cached fit points selected at each sampled column maximum; complete Cartesian jets.
